title: Knowledge snapshot: weekly cluster history (clusters-history.json) with lineage events
description:
Requested by the Shipped session for Ryan ("Yes, do both", 2026-10-31). Planning, no rush ahead of the Shipped console move.

Goal: the knowledge snapshot exposes a per-week cluster history so a site can render a "cluster river" (signals per cluster per week, with births, merges and splits) and a "what continued, was born, merged or split" panel.

Shape: for each weekly asOf, each cluster's stable id, label and item count, plus lineage events (born, continued, merged_from, split_into). The topic-model stage already keeps topic identity against the previous run in S3; expose that as clusters-history.json beside clusters.json in the knowledge snapshot, and add a KnowledgeSource accessor (e.g. history()) for projectors.

Consumer: Shipped-web hooks _map_river and _map_sample_river_html (Map) and the Front changes panel.

Acceptance: Gherkin for history across three weekly runs with a birth, a merge and a split; the snapshot file and accessor documented; no identity data; reconcile treats the file as task-owned.
